# Awesome AI Model Showcases

**Latest-model production cases, with the post, the author, and the prompt.**

Awesome AI Model Showcases collects real public production cases from the latest large models (Claude Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2, Gemini 4 Argon / Carbon, GPT-6.2 Sol, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek, and others) and from the previous generation that is still mainstream: GIFs, animations, HTML and game demos, and images, each with the original post, author, published prompt, and method.

<a id="how-to-use"></a>
## What can I do with this catalog?

1. **Pick a family and a version** in the list above.
2. **Open the case.** `docs/cases/<id>/` holds the author, the original post, and `prompt.md`. That file is the published wording, a partial prompt when that is all the source gives, or an explicit unpublished marker. A prompt file does not mean a full prompt exists.
3. **Read the method.** Native animation, HTML or game demos, sprite sheets, and post-processing are different pipelines. Reproduction still depends on model access and settings.

No account, API key, or install is required to browse. If this saves you a search, **star the repository**. To help it grow, send an original source or correct an attribution.

<a id="local-setup"></a>
## How do I browse locally?

Only Python 3 is needed to serve the static gallery. Browsing does not generate images or call an API.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-ai-model-showcases.git
cd awesome-ai-model-showcases
python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory docs
```

Open **[http://localhost:8000/?lang=en](http://localhost:8000/?lang=en)**. Switch to `?lang=zh` for Simplified Chinese. The web gallery does not yet have Traditional Chinese or Japanese UI; those editions are the README files.

<details>
<summary><strong>For contributors: structure and validation</strong></summary>

```text
docs/cases/<id>/          Original media or source notes, prompt.md, post.md, attribution
docs/data/                Generated catalog and local-media manifest
playbooks/research/       Source inventories and evidence
playbooks/community-cases.md  Complete evidence index
tools/templates/          README templates: en, zh-CN, zh-TW, ja
tools/                    Generators, media probes, and validators
```

The site uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on GitHub Pages. Python + Pillow validate images; `ffprobe` checks MP4 streams when installed, with an ISO-BMFF fallback locally. CI installs ffmpeg.

```bash
python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python3 tools/write_community_catalog.py
# Stage intentional generated changes before the freshness check.
git add README.md README.zh-CN.md README.zh-TW.md README.ja.md playbooks/community-cases.md docs/data/community-cases.json docs/data/cases.js llms.txt docs/llms.txt docs/github-about.json
python3 tools/verify.py
```

Edit source inventories and templates, not generated README or catalog outputs. See the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md).

</details>

<a id="contribute"></a>
## How do I submit a case?

**[Open the case submission form](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-ai-model-showcases/issues/new?template=case-submission.yml)**. No coding required: share the original author, source URL, media links, published prompt or “unpublished,” and model or pipeline evidence.

Prefer a pull request? Follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Corrections to attribution, broken links, prompt wording, or any of the four README languages help. Every featured creator stays credited.

<a id="faq"></a>
## What is this repository?

A source-first library of real production cases from the latest large models and from the previous generation that is still mainstream. It is organized by model family, then version. It is not this repository's original playbook showcase. **GPT Image 2.6** is one populated family, not the front door. Claude, Gemini, GPT-6.2 Sol, Grok, Qwen, and DeepSeek hold the newer sourced cases. The GPT-6.2 Sol section name follows the repo owner; OpenAI’s public pages still document GPT-6.1 Sol as of the last check. Each record keeps authorship, source links, local media where retrieved, prompt availability, model evidence, pipeline, and verification status. Model names from sources are claims, not independent verification.

## What can this repository not do?

- Generate images or provide an API application.
- Certify model origin or claim exhaustive web coverage. Author claim ≠ official verification; officially verified 2.6 game outputs: **0**.
- Treat an X “GIF” label as proof of GIF format. Many archived attachments are MP4, with no completed visual review or reproduction claim.
- Treat remakes, SVG concept art, or rewritten prompts as community originals. [Idea and popular-remake appendices](https://jammyfu.github.io/awesome-ai-model-showcases/ideas.html) and six local seed GIFs stay separate from the main count.
- Fill an empty version, including Claude Mythos 5.2, with a case that is not already in the inventory.

<a id="rights"></a>
## What are the license boundaries?

Media rights, in short: [MIT](LICENSE) covers source code and original project documentation. It does **not** license third-party media, prompts, trademarks, or likenesses. Archived third-party files remain **license unknown** unless a grant is documented. Public availability is not author permission or CC0.

Read [MEDIA_RIGHTS.md](MEDIA_RIGHTS.md) before reuse. Rights holders can [open an issue](https://github.com/jammyfu/awesome-ai-model-showcases/issues/new) with the case URL to request an attribution change or removal.

## Which languages are maintained?

**English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, and 日本語** share one inventory and the same case counts. Original quotes and prompts stay in their source language. The web catalog supports `?lang=en` / `?lang=zh` only. Idea and popular-remake appendices are Chinese-first, not a second synchronized catalog.
